claim: CI flake: claude_code_sessions_are_listed_and_imported_with_their_history panics at saved_meta(...).expect("saved") when the machine is loaded, because yardd's store writes the session row on a batching writer thread after the created reply, and the test reads the database once.
head: 937650885a23521e85df3e7dcb75989cb9c2381f

proofs.text: no-repro: a load-dependent race, seen once in the #250 verifier's full cargo run beside a map run (passed 3/3 alone). 30 parallel runs at base (6 at a time) did not reproduce it either. The store's writer thread batches writes (crates/yardd/src/store.rs), so the row can land after 'created'.
no-failing-test: the fix is to the test itself; making the race fire on demand would need a delay injected into yardd's writer.
